summary: Conservative whole-engine map reconciled from seven validated stage-1 proposals (generic_runtime_objects_01, math_and_collision_01, ui_platform_and_options_01, vehicle_ai_and_pit_01, vehicle_physics_01, vehicle_physics_02a, vehicle_physics_02b). Five engine subsystems are retained with their DERIVED responsibilities and function inventories. Nineteen canonical type families are proposed: eleven stand as single-proposal families (UIControlWindow, VehiclePhysicsBody, HeightfieldProximityProcessor, GenericLinkedNode, SessionScoringManager, CollisionPrimitives, CollisionModel, SparseConstraintSolver, PlayerOptions, WaypointNode, RacingLineSteeringController, VehiclePhysicsNode, VehicleTireModel, WheelSpringDamperState, VehicleControlState, PhysicsStateBuffer, TireModelData, TheSvmHdvVehicleFileParser), while the AI F1CVehicle view, the physics VehiclePhysicsBody timestep view and the per-frame physics Vehicle view are merged into one canonical F1CVehicle family on the strength of shared vehicle-struct offsets (+0x000032BC, +0x000032C8, +0x000035A0) and the shared control-commit fields (+0x0000357C/+0x00003580/+0x00003584). The generic_runtime_objects_01 VehiclePhysicsBody (0x0045A8E0) is kept separate because its offset space and role are unrelated to the vehicle struct. Seven state machines, sixteen interfaces and twenty-nine compatibility contracts are carried over from the proposals. Eight conflicts are recorded rather than erased: the VehiclePhysicsBody name collision, the +0x000032C8 aiEnableFlag/vehicleMode semantic clash, the +0x00003510/+0x00003514 and +0x00000CC8/+0x00000D0C dual-role fields, the shared +0x00000130/+0x00000134 316-byte element array seen by HeightfieldProximityProcessor and CollisionModel, the shape-only CollisionPrimitives grouping, and the ambiguous SuspendThreadWithMutex ai/ui ownership boundary. The two sparse LDLT kernels and the physics-matrix row initializer touch the same global double workspace (0x008D2120..0x008D3978); that is recorded as a shared-state dependency, not a merge. No trust was promoted: all claims stay DERIVED/GUESS/UNKNOWN.

engine_subsystems.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
engine_subsystems.responsibility: Generic runtime object support layer: counted-loop iteration helpers, vehicle physics-body state, fixed-stride element/proximity processing, large UI control-window construction with per-sub-control blocks, reusable linked-node initializers, and session/scoring struct reset.

engine_subsystems.name: MathAndCollision
engine_subsystems.responsibility: Stateless geometry/vector math primitives (ray-sphere intersection, 2D direction projection, SSE two-point interpolation), a collision-geometry container owning strut and struct arrays with nearest-neighbor queries and destructor teardown, and two standalone global-workspace sparse-matrix LDLT constraint solvers.

engine_subsystems.name: UiPlatformAndOptions
engine_subsystems.responsibility: Options/settings UI platform: builds and owns the player options tree (named category groups of typed 9-dword entries, string-field registrations, default control-action key bindings, root enable flag life-cycle), destroys UI objects through a vtable-installing base-chain destructor, sets device state 18 via a vtable+252 dispatch, and suspends an AI thread under mutex.

engine_subsystems.name: VehicleAIPitControl
engine_subsystems.responsibility: Per-frame AI driver control and pit-stop decision logic for race vehicles: AI tick orchestration (pre-race init vs racing path), waypoint/racing-line following, steering-target computation and lane scoring, driver-status state machine, AI ability drift, and tire-compound pit-stop scheduling with retirement.

engine_subsystems.name: VehiclePhysics
engine_subsystems.responsibility: Per-frame vehicle physics (suspension strut contact solving and swept collision detection, tire/grip force propagation with distance falloff, per-wheel spring/damper forces, tire-model session initialization, steering geometry, vehicle-level control and physics timestep integration, wheel/suspension force simulation, contact-patch and weight-distribution updates), the per-vehicle tire model configuration data, vehicle configuration loading (.SVM/.HDV parsing into a setup struct and a normalized output vehicle-state struct), and physics dynamics-matrix identity initialization.

canonical_type_families.name: F1CVehicle
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Shared race vehicle object. Merged from three proposal views: the AI field block and shared vehicle fields (position, velocity, heading, gear, engine RPM, fuel, car conditions) read/written by the AI tick (proposal vehicle_ai_and_pit_01:0); the physics timestep and wheel-dynamics state (packed-input decode, mode-specific setup/vibration dispatch, per-wheel 62-dword dynamics records) of vehicle_physics_01:2; and the per-vehicle runtime state (wheel contact geometry, weight distribution, stride-248 per-wheel state blocks, drivetrain, engine, aero, force accumulators, 13-point contact output, particle/effect state) of vehicle_physics_02a:0. Merging is supported by the shared offsets +0x000032BC/+0x000032C8 (physics-mode vs AI-enable gate), +0x000035A0 (wheel-dynamics records) and the control-commit fields +0x0000357C/+0x00003580/+0x00003584.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Boundary clues only, never a complete layout. The three proposals are offset-space views over one vehicle struct; overlapping offsets (+0x000032BC, +0x000032C8, +0x000035A0, +0x0000357C/+0x00003580/+0x00003584) are treated as the same object, but per-field semantics are preserved per view and the +0x000032C8 clash (aiEnableFlag vs vehicleMode) is recorded in conflicts rather than resolved here.

canonical_type_families.name: UIControlWindow
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Large UI control window object: leading callback/state dwords, a ~200-element array of per-sub-control blocks (each holding a vtable header, a state dword reset to 0, and a target/sentinel dword set to -1), tail flags, and player-options defaults; constructed by 0x004A70E0.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Boundary clues only. The bulk per-sub-control block offsets are preserved as evidence (field:this:0x00000124..0x00001FF0) without forcing per-block meaning; block layout written inside InitWithSentinelValues (0x004A8B10) is callee-internal.

canonical_type_families.name: VehiclePhysicsBody
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Small vehicle physics body object (proposal generic_runtime_objects_01:1): speed-limit storage at +0x00000024 and clamping against +0x0000001C/+0x00000020, velocity/angular-velocity integration (step 0.0125) via 0x00459AE0 when +0x000000D0 is enabled, attitude-angle computation, 3D position doubles at +0x000000D8/+0x000000E0/+0x000000E8, and conditional reset paths. Kept separate from the merged F1CVehicle family because its offset space and role are unrelated to the vehicle struct; the name collides with the physics-timestep proposal (see conflicts).
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Boundary clues only. Field samples (+0x0000001C..+0x00000140) are preserved as evidence; motion-component and reset-seed names are GUESS labels for uniformly-read double/dword runs, not a confirmed layout.

canonical_type_families.name: HeightfieldProximityProcessor
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Processes a fixed-stride element table anchored at +0x00000134 with count at +0x00000130 (316-byte stride), driving VehicleProximity (0x004FB2E0) per element; invoked from heightfield collision processing (0x00404250). Shares its element-array anchors and stride with CollisionModel; the two are kept separate pending owner evidence (see conflicts).
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Boundary clues only: two anchors (count +0x00000130, table base +0x00000134). Element type/size is not confirmed; the 316-byte stride is prose evidence, not a field sample.

canonical_type_families.name: GenericLinkedNode
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Reusable three-field linked node (data dword at +0x00000000, next pointer at +0x00000004, byte flag at +0x00000008) initialized by 0x004BAC20; used as a node constructor across directory, collision, physics, AI, and network subsystems.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Boundary clues only. Whether +0x00000000 holds an integer or a pointer, and whether 0x004BAC20 is invoked as a C++ constructor (this in ECX) or a plain initializer, is unconfirmed; layout beyond +0x00000008 is not evidenced.

canonical_type_families.name: SessionScoringManager
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Racing/session scoring management struct: owns three allocations (+0x0000008C, +0x00000090, +0x00000094), a '1'-counted byte array (+0x00000094 counted into +0x00000098), ~40 scalar/vector fields with -1.0/0/-1 defaults, and a trailing 0x28-byte 0xFF-sentinel block; reset by 0x004BB950 which returns -1.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Boundary clues only. The ~42 field samples are reset-literal writes (neg_one_float, zero_float, zero_dword, sentinel_block); names are GUESS labels for value patterns, and the +0x0000008C/+0x00000090/+0x00000094 allocations are pointers accessed in raw source, not declared fields.

canonical_type_families.name: CollisionPrimitives
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Stateless geometric/vector math primitives: ray-sphere quadratic intersection (suspension contact, 0x00401180), 2D direction projection (0x00423AD0), and SSE two-point linear interpolation (0x0051F6A0). Grouped by shape only; the packet assigns each function an UNKNOWN owner and proves no shared class (see conflicts).
canonical_type_families.field_policy: No instance fields proven; the two field samples (+0x00000000, +0x00000008) are the x/z components of the 2D projection vectors, not class members.

canonical_type_families.name: CollisionModel
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Container object owning the collision geometry arrays: a 316-byte-stride element (strut) array at +0x00000134 with count at +0x00000130, a 28-byte-stride struct array at +0x00000154, and further owned buffers at +0x00000150/+0x00000158. Supports nearest-neighbor queries over linked nodes and struts (0x00403640), indexed struct reads (0x00403F70), and a destructor-style teardown (0x004045F0) freeing every owned allocation. Name is descriptive; packet reports owner UNKNOWN at the function-IR level.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Boundary clues only. The +0x00000130/+0x00000134 anchors and the +0x00000150/+0x00000154/+0x00000158 owned pointers are the strong samples; +0x00000138 (reset-only) and +0x00000148 (released sentinel) are GUESS. Node-link offsets +0x110/+0x10C and strut-entry selector +0x12C are documented in prose but have no allowed field refs, so they are not modeled as fields.

canonical_type_families.name: SparseConstraintSolver
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Standalone numeric kernel: block LDL^T factorization and substitution solve of sparse dynamics constraint matrices stored in global double workspaces (0x008CFBF0..0x008D3B60 and 0x008D2120..0x008D3978) indexed by global row-pointer arrays. Two independent functions (0x0056FA96, 0x00575BBD) grouped by shared algorithm and overlapping global workspace region; no parameters, no callees, returns 0.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: No instance fields; the object is a numeric kernel over global buffers. The 0x008D2120..0x008D3978 region is also written by the physics-matrix row initializer 0x00578F76; the shared-state dependency is recorded, not resolved.

canonical_type_families.name: PlayerOptions
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Owns and initializes the player options / settings tree: named category groups (Scene, Driver, DrivingAids, RaceConditions, SoundOptions, GraphicOptions, GameOptions, MultiplayerOptions, Options, Controls) of 9-dword (36-byte) option entries, string-field registrations, control-action default key bindings, and the root enable flag life-cycle. Built by 0x004AA270 under UIControlWindowInitialization (0x004A70E0).
canonical_type_families.field_policy: No vehicle-style field samples: the option-entry layout (label char*, value/min/max/selector dwords, description char*, offsets 0x0..0x14 of a 36-byte entry, plus three trailing unproven dwords) is inferred from recurring 4-dword writes but the packet carries no field evidence refs for those offsets, so it is recorded in unresolved rather than emitted as class fields.

canonical_type_families.name: WaypointNode
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Waypoint-graph node reached through vehicle pointer fields (0x4354 current, 0x4358 chain base, 0x4364 third chain node, 0x4400 lead reference, forward-link at +0x114). Holds position, tangent, up-vector, track distance, lateral boundaries, grip/traction, heading and node-id/pit-entry flag.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Boundary clues only. Field samples are reached through dereferenced vehicle pointers (field:*(this+0x4354):..., field:*(this+0x4400):...) and are GUESS-named by geometric role; the node layout beyond the listed offsets is unresolved and link navigation is by array index in raw source.

canonical_type_families.name: RacingLineSteeringController
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Per-frame AI steering-target computation: 5-lane boundary scan, centre-steering computation, lane scoring via spatial nearest-neighbour queries, and overtaking state transitions on the vehicle. Owns 0x004270A0.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: No instance field samples; the controller reads the vehicle struct and waypoint spatial tree (global:0x005EA2C0) rather than owning state of its own.

canonical_type_families.name: VehiclePhysicsNode
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Owns the vehicle suspension strut array (count +0x00000130, base +0x00000134, stride 316 bytes) and the per-frame suspension solver chain: per-strut contact solving (0x00401340), swept contact detection (0x00401910), and tire/grip force propagation with distance falloff (0x00401C90), writing the maximum propagated force at +0x00000148.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Boundary clues only. The +0x00000130/+0x00000134 array anchors and +0x00000148 maximum-force slot are the strong samples; the strut-relative element layout (strut+24, +72, +112..+156, +268, +272) is raw-source prose and is not modeled as field evidence.

canonical_type_families.name: VehicleTireModel
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Tire physics configuration object: per-wheel compliance matrices, tire compound application, suspension compliance and attach-point geometry, session setup envelope, interpolated curve table, and thermal/wear session state. Initialized by 0x0043C250 (TireModelFullInitialize), which ends a session by setting +0x00000030 = -2 and +0x00000034 = 3.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Boundary clues only. Strong samples are the init markers (+0x00000030/+0x00000034), tire brand/compound ids (+0x00001458/+0x0000145C), curve table (+0x00001CFC/+0x00001D08) and wear seed (+0x00001DB4); +0x00000070 hudDisableFlag is DERIVED from a global write.

canonical_type_families.name: WheelSpringDamperState
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Per-wheel spring/damper force computation (0x004E3D00): builds the suspension frame (near-vertical fast path and 2D fallback), computes spring/damper forces from wheel velocity, clamps to the friction/grip circle and writes force components along the wheel local axes.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Boundary clues only. Fifteen float samples are named by geometric/force role (suspensionAxis, wheelVelocity, springStiffness, forceOut); the second parameter (contact-patch frame, 9 floats) layout is inferred from usage and not described by the packet.

canonical_type_families.name: VehicleControlState
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Vehicle control and steering state: maps raw controller input into steering/throttle/brake commands (0x004441F0), applies steering damping and per-wheel steering geometry (0x00442060), runs collision avoidance and lap/position transitions, and distributes torque/brake to the wheels. GUESS grouping on overlapping offset ranges; common ownership with the F1CVehicle physics views is NOT proven.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Boundary clues only. Output fields (steeringOutput +0x00000000, throttleOutput +0x00000008, brakeOutput +0x00000010, offsetOutput +0x00000020) are the strongest samples; pointer fields (+0x000000B4, +0x0000011C, +0x000015F0, +0x000015C0) are DERIVED but their targets are unresolved.

canonical_type_families.name: PhysicsStateBuffer
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Small physics state buffer object cleared per-frame by 0x004358F0: zeroes dwords 0..38 of the 40-dword buffer, frees the heap pointer at +0x0000009C through the free wrapper when present, nulls it and returns the previous pointer.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Boundary clues only; a single strong sample (+0x0000009C heap buffer pointer). Called from constructor/suspension-setup/wheel-dynamics-init paths.

canonical_type_families.name: TireModelData
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Per-vehicle tire model configuration data constructed once by 0x004F34E0 (ABI lead Tire_Model_Data_Init, LEGACY): handle sentinels (primary 0, others -1), compound count 15, friction/camber/slip coefficient seeding, multiple zero-init sub-structures and zero runs, four 66-dword physics-default sub-structs, and a config-path string copy through StringCopyWithBufferRealloc from global 0x005EA438.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Boundary clues only. Header samples (handle 0x00000000, sentinels 0x00000004..0x00000038, compound count 0x0000003C) are the strongest; offset space 0x0..+0x13CC numerically overlaps the vehicle offset space and the two bases are kept separate per evidence, though embedding within a larger vehicle allocation is possible and unproven.

canonical_type_families.name: TheSvmHdvVehicleFileParser
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Parse .SVM/.HDV vehicle configuration files (line-by-line, '='-delimited, named sections General/FrontWing/LeftFender/RightFender/RearWing/BodyAero/Diffuser/Suspension/Controls/Engine/Driveline/per-wheel corners/Basic) into an internal setup struct (this) and produce a normalized output vehicle-state struct (a3); dispatch named sections to section readers and resolve secondary files relative to the config path. Owns 0x004F4270; owner identity is DERIVED from the LEGACY ABI lead The_svm_hdv_Vehicle_File_Parser.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Boundary clues only. Thirteen setup-struct samples (tire_compound_rpm_multiplier, rules_setting, garage_display_flags, wing drag loaded flags, engine map scale doubles, wheel_drive_classification, forward_gear_count) are DERIVED from writes; the a3 output-struct layout is only partially mapped (byte flags and engine-scale doubles at offsets 6540..6552) and is recorded in unresolved.

states.name: Active
states.description: state-18 value 1 dispatched for a2 == 1 when 0x008B8C48 bit 0 clear

states.name: ActiveForced
states.description: state-18 value 2 dispatched for a2 == 1 when 0x008B8C48 bit 0 set

states.name: OtherValue
states.description: a2 values other than 0/1 stored at this+0x34 without dispatch

transitions.action: dispatch vtable+252 on global 0x008B89A0 with state 18; record this[13] = a2
FlagSetterWithGlobalUpdate sets root enable flag to 1
FlagSetterWithGlobalUpdate clears root enable flag to 0, then EmptyStub finalizer

state_machines.name: DriverStatusMachine
transitions: pit-wait timer 0x00004170 < now -> driverStatus = 4 (session type 0x007C56A4==7) else 5, then re-arm pit-exit timer 0x0000447C
0x0000447C snapshot timer -> toggle 6/0 and snapshot position into 0x00004470/0x00004474/0x00004478
1 -> sub_4258C0; 2 -> FieldZeroSetter and return; 3 -> waypoint squared-distance vs 0x0000461C -> 0 when farther, else update 0x0000461C
steering-error accumulator 0x0000446C > 0x00004558 -> driverStatus = 1 (after RaceStartCountdownStateUpdate when gear 0x000039FC > 2)
racing-line reset path -> driverStatus = 4/5 by 0x007C56A4; pit-return 5 -> 3 after tier selection or -> 0

state_machines.name: PitStopDecisionMachine
transitions: PitStopBlockingCondition or session != 7 -> not service-ready; when session==7 set RetiredFlag 0x00004410=1, clear AIControlFlag 0x000045F4, log via sub_4BC060
service-ready path -> tire-compound tier selection and SpeedValueSetterWithGlobalMirror + PostPitCleanup

state_machines.name: VehicleModeDispatch
states: mode 2 = full setup-data copy + 14 subsystem state machines
mode 3 = vibration path + 4 vibration state machines + 14 subsystem state machines
other modes = no mode-specific body; all paths converge on effect/audio flag derivation
transitions: this+0x000032C8 is read each frame; values 2 and 3 dispatch distinct bodies, everything else skips the mode body
both mode bodies end in the common braking/effect/bit-flag derivation and effect-field update

state_machines.name: PitLimiterHudState
states: state 1 = pit limiter engaged (calls HUDElementConfig(41, 2, blend))
state 2 = pit limiter with weather-noise blend, cleared when throttle output this+0x8 < 0.8
transitions: state 0 -> 1 when pit flag dword_7CC368 set, this+0x1D34 != 0, this+0x1EF0 == 0 and vehicle state mode this+0x000000D0 != 2 (guard:6)
state 1 -> 2 when the pit flag clears
state 2 is cleared when throttle output drops below 0.8

state_machines.name: TireWearModeSwitch
states: wear mode 0 = wear disabled: NaN-boxed max double written to this+0x1DB8 and the four wheel wear blocks zeroed
wear modes 1..3 = wheel wear blocks scaled by flt_8ACF9C over 4 iterations
transitions: read global dword_7CEA5C: 0 selects disable, 1..3 select scaling
when session type dword_7C56A4 == 7, this+0x1DB4 is additionally divided by flt_8ACF9C

interfaces.name: ISubControlBlockInitializer
interfaces.purpose: Uniform per-sub-control-block construction invoked by UIControlWindow::Initialize (0x004A70E0): each member constructs one block (sentinel seed, vtable header, state reset) via stride-based loops and batch iteration (0x00401000).

interfaces.name: SettingsGroupBuilder
interfaces.purpose: Builds the named category path (e.g. Scene, Driver, SoundOptions) under which option entries are registered.

interfaces.name: StringFieldRegistrar
interfaces.purpose: Registers a string-valued field into the current settings group (used for scene file, profile vehicle, telemetry exe/file, GDB filename, player livery).

interfaces.name: SpatialWaypointQuery
interfaces.purpose: Nearest-neighbour, plane-test and indexed-field copy queries over the shared waypoint spatial tree (dword_5EA2C0) used by racing-line, waypoint-following and steering.

interfaces.name: AICommandQueue
interfaces.purpose: AI command-message queue: dispatch of pit-lane/waypoint-set commands (message id 14) and ring-buffer input selection for the AI tick.

interfaces.name: SpatialGridQueryService
interfaces.purpose: Spatial-grid contact lookup and collision-surface normal extraction used by the suspension contact solver.

interfaces.name: TireForceSolverService
interfaces.purpose: Per-strut tire, grip and lateral force computation used by the swept contact pass and the per-frame force-propagation pass.

interfaces.name: MatrixTransformLibrary
interfaces.purpose: 3x3 matrix-vector transforms, rotation tensors, Euler-to-rotation and coordinate-frame conversions shared across steering, suspension and physics-step code.

interfaces.name: PackedPacketDecoder
interfaces.purpose: Decodes the packed per-frame input packet into orientation components, steering bitfields, per-wheel data, velocity short-vectors, floats and subsystem bits.

interfaces.name: TireCompoundResolution
interfaces.purpose: Resolve the tire brand (TireBrandLookup on global table 0x008AD254 with the session compound id a3+136) and then the compound index (CompoundIndexLookup on the brand pointer and the compound selection) into the two base pointers into the compound data used by the wheel force evaluation.

interfaces.name: SuspensionForceEvaluation
interfaces.purpose: Per-wheel suspension and tire force helper models: suspension force split (VehicleSuspensionForceHelper), quadratic/cubic polynomial evaluators, tire force/torque computation, quadratic force model, linear vehicle parameter evaluation, and quadratic force/torque curve evaluation, whose outputs feed the force summation.

interfaces.name: WheelStateInitialization
interfaces.purpose: Initialize the per-wheel suspension/tire state from the wheel index, contact offset pointer, and steering-direction magnitudes (WheelSuspensionTireStateInit).

interfaces.name: RuntimeParameterHelpers
interfaces.purpose: Auxiliary runtime value generators used by the per-frame update: parameterized torque-curve interpolation, random offset and bias value computation, arithmetic comparison/validation, and float-to-int conversion and allocation count arithmetic.

interfaces.name: AllocationAndSystemServices
interfaces.purpose: Memory allocation and system helper services: operator-new wrapper and float-to-int conversion, LCG random seeding, triple-field position query, vertex/particle buffer allocation, direction-vector projection, and config-path string copy with reallocation.

interfaces.name: SimulationServices
interfaces.purpose: Simulation-level services invoked from the per-frame update and the tire model data constructor: session-state indexed lookup, pit-part state copy, engine wear/failure simulation, 3x3 matrix transform with translation, loop-with-conditional-subcall, and the zero-init/sub-constructor helpers.

interfaces.name: ConfigTokenReader
interfaces.purpose: Low-level token/line readers and section-header matcher used by the SVM/HDV parser to decode individual config lines into typed values and to route lines to section readers.

compatibility_contracts.name: UIWindowSubControlInit
compatibility_contracts.description: Constructing the profile/exists UI window must zero the leading callback/state fields (+0x00000000..+0x00000010), seed every sub-control block with sentinel defaults, assign vtable pointers from the fixed table 0x005ACB6C..0x005ACBFC, reset each block's state dword to 0 and target/sentinel to -1, zero the tail flags, and apply player-options defaults (0x004AA270).

compatibility_contracts.name: VehiclePhysicsBodySpeedLimit
compatibility_contracts.description: A speed-limit request must be stored at +0x00000024, clamped against the +0x0000001C/+0x00000020 bounds, and, when within bounds and integration enabled (+0x000000D0), integrated at step 0.0125 and emitted as 3D position (+0x000000D8/+0x000000E0/+0x000000E8) via 0x0054B4D0; out-of-range requests follow the clamp or reset path.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionScoringStructReset
compatibility_contracts.description: Resetting the session/scoring struct must free the +0x0000008C, +0x00000090, and +0x00000094 allocations, count '1' entries of the +0x00000094 byte array into +0x00000098 before freeing, restore ~40 scalar fields (floats to -1.0, indexes to 0/-1), memset the trailing 0x28 bytes to 0xFF, and return -1.

compatibility_contracts.name: SuspensionRaySphereContact
compatibility_contracts.description: Ray-sphere quadratic intersection used by the vehicle suspension force calculation: takes six doubles, returns 0.0 on any miss and 1/sqrt(p) as a penetration-length proxy on hit. Must remain a pure scalar float-returning function with no side effects or callees.

compatibility_contracts.name: CollisionModelOwnedBufferLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: The collision container owns pointer buffers at +0x00000150/+0x00000154/+0x00000158 and a 316-byte-stride element array at +0x00000134 (count +0x00000130) whose allocation is length-prefixed 4 bytes before the base. Teardown frees each non-null buffer via FreeWrapper, runs per-element release (0x004B0170) over the element array, frees the array allocation, nulls the pointers, writes -1.0f at +0x00000148, clears +0x00000130/+0x00000134/+0x00000138, and returns the prior array base.

compatibility_contracts.name: NearestNeighborQueryResult
compatibility_contracts.description: Nearest-neighbor query walks linked collision nodes (next pointers at +0x110/+0x10C) and the strut array (316-byte stride, entries with type field at +0x12C <= 1 distance-tested), using a signed plane-distance probe (0x004FB6D0). Returns a node pointer, preferring the plane-verified candidate when its final signed distance is non-negative.

compatibility_contracts.name: SparseConstraintSolverWorkspace
compatibility_contracts.description: Two standalone LDLT solvers factor global double constraint-matrix workspaces (0x008CFBF0..0x008D3B60 and 0x008D2120..0x008D3978) indexed by global row-pointer arrays (0x008D3988..0x008D3A24 and 0x008D3B68..0x008D3BF0); both take no parameters and return 0. A replacement must keep these global buffers and pointer tables byte-compatible.

compatibility_contracts.name: UIObjectLifetime
compatibility_contracts.description: UI object destruction must install vtable 0x005AC830 at this+0x00000000, chain to the base UI destructor (0x00485EB0), and when the flag argument has bit 0 set free the object allocation via FreeWrapper; the call still returns this.

compatibility_contracts.name: DeviceState18Set
compatibility_contracts.description: Setting device state 18 for a2 0/1 must dispatch through vtable+252 on the object at global 0x008B89A0 (state 18, value 0 / 1-or-2 depending on bit 0 of global byte 0x008B8C48), skip when a2 == -1 or equals the last applied value, and record the last applied value at this+0x00000034.

compatibility_contracts.name: PlayerOptionsTreeLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: The options/settings tree is populated as named category groups (Scene, Driver, DrivingAids, RaceConditions, SoundOptions, GraphicOptions, GameOptions, MultiplayerOptions, Options, Controls); each option entry is a 9-dword (36-byte) group holding a label, value/min/max/selector dwords and a description string; indexed lists use 7-entry loops with per-index formatted names; all control actions are bound to default key codes; the root enable flag is set to 1 at start and cleared to 0 at end.

compatibility_contracts.name: ControlOutputCommitContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Every AI tick path must write committed control outputs into the input fields this+0x00003580 (throttle), this+0x00003584 (brake), this+0x0000357C (steering) before returning; the racing fallthrough writes neutral (0, 1.0, 0). A replacement executable must preserve this commit location and neutrality.

compatibility_contracts.name: DriverStatusContract
compatibility_contracts.description: driverStatus at this+0x00004510 must keep the documented 0..7 semantics: pit entry forces 4 or 5 (session type 0x007C56A4==7 selects 4), 6 is follow-target steering, 7 stops the car until Speed<0.2, and the racing-line reset forces 4/5 by the same session-type rule.

compatibility_contracts.name: AIEnableGateContract
compatibility_contracts.description: aiEnableFlag at this+0x000032C8 gates the whole AI tick: AIMainUpdate returns immediately when >1, and the racing tick re-checks obj+0x000032C8==1. A replacement must preserve both guards.

compatibility_contracts.name: PitLaneFlagContract
compatibility_contracts.description: PitLaneRouteFlag this+0x00004548 and the pit-lane byte this+0x000045F4 steer the pit-box/pit-lane steering overrides in computeSteeringTarget and gate the pre-race init path in AIMainUpdate; PitStopDecisionTireCompound sets 0x00004548=1 on entry.

compatibility_contracts.name: WaypointTreeContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The waypoint spatial tree dword_5EA2C0 and its count/global neighbours (0x005EA2CC, 0x005EA2D0) back the nearest-neighbour queries; waypoint node id at +0x12C and the set selector this+0x00004550 drive pit-lane command dispatch (message id 14).

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionPhaseContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Global session type dword_7C56A4 and phase dword_7C56A8 select the driver-status pit values, the countdown/launch ramp (dword_5C30E0 / dword_5C3144 tables, global byte_5C3160), the ability drift, and the retirement path; simulation time dbl_8AFEA0 is the shared clock for all timers.

compatibility_contracts.name: RetiredFlagContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Retirement sets RetiredFlag at this+0x00004410 and clears AIControlFlag at this+0x000045F4, then logs through sub_4BC060; AIDriverStructInit clears both when a session (re)starts.

compatibility_contracts.name: SuspensionStrutArrayLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: The vehicle physics node exposes a suspension strut array at this+0x00000134 with stride 316 bytes and element count this+0x00000130. Per strut the solver writes contact state (penetration depths at +112/+116, gravity-compensated contact force at +120/+124/+128), force propagation results at +136/+140 and a candidate force slot at +144, reads the wheel position at +148/+152/+156 and travel scale at +24, and requires linked-node (+268) and contact-feature (+272) pointers to be non-null for contact processing. VehicleSuspensionForceCalculation / SweptSuspensionCollisionDetection / PhysicsNodePropagationWithDistanceFalloff all share this array and per-strut ABI.

compatibility_contracts.name: PhysicsStateBufferClearContract
compatibility_contracts.description: PhysicsBufferClear zeroes dwords 0..38 of the 40-dword buffer on the this object, frees the pointer stored at +0x0000009C through the free wrapper (0x00587BCF) and nulls it, returning the previous pointer (or 0). Callers are ConstructorStub (004353F0), SuspensionSetupSectionReader (00435410) and WheelDynamicsInit (0043E230), so the buffer is reset during vehicle/tire construction and wheel-dynamics initialization.

compatibility_contracts.name: WheelDynamicsRecordArrayLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: The vehicle physics body owns four wheel-dynamics records at this+0x000035A0 with stride 62 dwords. VehiclePhysicsTimeStep stores per-wheel force values at this+0x000035BC + i*62 dwords (mode 2), while WheelStateReset re-initializes the records each frame, setting identity 1.0 at record-relative indices 22/23/39 and zeroing the leading accumulator entries, and the first-frame guard this+0x000032BC drives WheelDynamicsInit(0x007C7428).

compatibility_contracts.name: PackedInputPacketFormat
compatibility_contracts.description: Per-frame vehicle input arrives as a packed packet: the region at packet+8 encodes orientation components, a steering bitfield, per-wheel data, a velocity short-vector, floats and subsystem bits decoded by the helper family 0x004B2420..0x004B2AD0. Auxiliary words at packet+52/+56/+59 carry flags: packet+52 bit 0x80 -> byte this+0x00001069, packet+56 bits 0x8000000/0x4000000/0x2000000 -> braking byte this+0x0000105D and effect bytes this+0x00001065/0x00001067, and packet+59 bit 1 -> byte this+0x00004024.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleSessionInitMarkers
compatibility_contracts.description: TireModelFullInitialize ends a session by setting this+0x00000030 = -2 and this+0x00000034 = 3 with this+0x00000038/+0x0000003C zeroed. VehicleMainPhysicsUpdate reads this+0x00000030 for the position-change state machine, and VehiclePhysicsTimeStep branches on the vehicle mode this+0x000032C8. A replacement must preserve these sentinel semantics across tire-model init, control-state updates and the physics timestep.

compatibility_contracts.name: PerWheelStateBlockLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Four per-wheel state blocks of 248-byte stride on the vehicle object (base 0x000035AC). The wheel-force field sits at block-relative offset 0x24 (absolute 0x00003664/0x0000375C/0x00003854/0x0000394C): SetWheelForceParameters stores four per-wheel force parameters there, and the per-frame update initializes and reads the same block layout. A replacement must preserve the stride and the block-relative offsets.

compatibility_contracts.name: ContactPointOutputBuffer
compatibility_contracts.description: The 13-point contact-position output buffer at vehicle+0x00003AB8 (stride 12 bytes) is computed each frame, copied into the 28-byte-stride wheel output array at +0x00001078, and consumed by the vertex/particle buffer allocation; the bounding radius is tracked at +0x00003B6C with +0x00003B70 = +0x00003B6C + 0.1. A replacement must produce all 13 points and publish them to +0x00001078.

compatibility_contracts.name: PhysicsModeGate
compatibility_contracts.description: The flag at vehicle+0x000032BC gates two paths: non-zero enables the per-frame suspension body-offset override and the wheel-force field-storage path in SetWheelForceParameters; zero disables the override and routes the same four parameters to a direct rigid-body force/torque application using the dbl_7C7428 scalar as the inertia-tensor argument. A replacement must preserve this gate's effect on both consumers.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionWheelRecordReturnPointer
compatibility_contracts.description: UpdateSuspensionAndWheelPhysics returns a pointer advanced through four per-wheel 33-double records starting at session+5200 (plus the axis blocks at session+5336/+5864). The caller 0x004E45B0 (LargeConfigFunctionWithPhysicsConstants) uses the returned advanced pointer; a replacement must reproduce the pointer arithmetic.

compatibility_contracts.name: TireModelDataHandleConvention
compatibility_contracts.description: The tire model data object's header uses handle sentinels (primary field 0, other handle slots -1), a compound count of 15, and alternating sentinel/zero handle pairs. Its config path is passed through StringCopyWithBufferRealloc from the global buffer 0x005EA438. A replacement must preserve the handle convention and the config-loading call.

compatibility_contracts.name: SvmHdvConfigFileFormat
compatibility_contracts.description: Line-based '='-delimited configuration files with named sections (General, FrontWing, LeftFender, RightFender, RearWing, BodyAero, Diffuser, Suspension, Controls, Engine, Driveline, Frontleft/Frontright/Rearleft/Rearright, Basic). Recognized header keywords include Setting/Notes/Downforce/Balance/Ride/Gearing/Custom/Symmetric. In non-server sessions a file with no recognized header is rejected as an illegal .SVM file. A replacement executable must preserve '=' delimiter handling, section dispatch, and the rejection path.

compatibility_contracts.name: PhysicsMatrixRowIdentity
compatibility_contracts.description: 0x00578F76 must set exactly one row of the double-precision dynamics matrix to an identity row (diagonal element 1.0, all other stored elements of that row 0.0), selected by argument 0..33, and return the selector argument unchanged on every path.

alternatives: F1CVehicle (AI) reads +0x000032C8 as aiEnableFlag gating the AI tick (returns when >1).

Written as the wheel-block header anti-roll mixing factors.

conflicts.subject: CollisionPrimitives grouping by shape only

alternatives: The packet describes 0x005855E0 as part of the ai subsystem.
0x005855E0 is delivered inside the ui_platform_and_options scope.
conflicts.resolution: Ownership boundary is ambiguous; the function stays unowned (UnknownObject) and both scopes are credited in the engine map.

Two solver instances plus an unrelated initializer that happen to touch 0x008D2120..0x008D3978.
